We are given the equation
$$0.2(2x-1) - 0.5(3x-1) = 0.4.$$
First, we distribute the terms in the parentheses:
$$0.2(2x) - 0.2(1) - 0.5(3x) + 0.5(1) = 0.4$$
$$0.4x - 0.2 - 1.5x + 0.5 = 0.4$$
Now, we combine like terms:
$$(0.4x - 1.5x) + (-0.2 + 0.5) = 0.4$$
$$-1.1x + 0.3 = 0.4$$
Subtract 0.3 from both sides of the equation:
$$-1.1x + 0.3 - 0.3 = 0.4 - 0.3$$
$$-1.1x = 0.1$$
Now, we divide both sides by -1.1:
$$\frac{-1.1x}{-1.1} = \frac{0.1}{-1.1}$$
$$x = -\frac{0.1}{1.1} = -\frac{1}{11}$$
Therefore, $x = -\frac{1}{11}$.

We can check our answer by plugging $x = -\frac{1}{11}$ into the original equation:
$$0.2\left(2\left(-\frac{1}{11}\right)-1\right) - 0.5\left(3\left(-\frac{1}{11}\right)-1\right) = 0.4$$
$$0.2\left(-\frac{2}{11} - 1\right) - 0.5\left(-\frac{3}{11} - 1\right) = 0.4$$
$$0.2\left(-\frac{2}{11} - \frac{11}{11}\right) - 0.5\left(-\frac{3}{11} - \frac{11}{11}\right) = 0.4$$
$$0.2\left(-\frac{13}{11}\right) - 0.5\left(-\frac{14}{11}\right) = 0.4$$
$$-\frac{2.6}{11} + \frac{7}{11} = 0.4$$
$$\frac{4.4}{11} = 0.4$$
$$0.4 = 0.4$$
Our answer is correct.

Final Answer: The final answer is $\boxed{-1/11}$
